description: Presidential Secretariat - appointed Commission of Inquiry by the President
categorisation: This gazette exclusively concerns government personnel changes - specifically the appointment of named individuals (W. K. K. Kumarasiri and M. P. Dharmawardana) to a Commission of Inquiry. It mentions their basic titles ("retired Secretary to Ministry" and "retired Deputy Auditor General") but does not include any detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) as it focuses on who is being appointed without detailing what they will be responsible for.
